tradition_assertions.notes: Reviewed work/title crosswalk: the Church's numbered list names Jonah; TAU's index gives the Latinized form Ionas and its book-specific page identifies the Ethiopic Book of Jonah. This is a title/work match only; the historical critical-edition transcription is not identified as the current Church print text and its accuracy/completeness remain unverified. British Library Add MS 16189's catalog lists the Twelve Prophets in this Ge'ez codex at folios 42v–64v and names a starting folio for each. This is manuscript-catalog evidence only; it does not verify a transcription, complete book boundaries, or identity with a particular current Church edition. Standard USFM title-candidate research readers are catalogued for Jonah.
